name: Impetus of Hecate
description:
You have dominion over past,_ present_, and future, granting the following spell effects:

  • Past: You reflect after every 3rd spell cast, causing your next spell tome swing to recast your last spell at no XP cost.
  • Present: You gain 25% runic spell power, and magic weapon kills collect loot and XP.
  • Future: You can sneak swing a spell tome to scry, casting its rightmost spell regardless of your current selection.
